text:
nina: Heads up 1: Vendor just pinged procurement: a container with 40 H100s hit a customs classification issue in FRA port. Theyre requesting additional RMA + repair origin paperwork before customs will release. ETA unknown.

omar: Do we have alternate spares in EU? What's the serial manifest?

nina: Manifest in secure drive. Vendor says they only cleared shipment with commercial invoice; customs asked for chain-of-custody and 'repaired' declaration for items moving under RMA terms. Weird.

kevin: Operational impact: our eu-edge pool capacity would drop ~9% if these are held. Canary for feature-x is slated for 08:00 CET tomorrow. We can mitigate by moving 6 GPUs from training-pool -> edge-pool short-term, or enable a cloud-backed Dedicated fallback for critical routes. Both have cost implications.

procurement-bot: New PR created: PR-6789 for provisional RMA fee coverage. Flagged approver: maria.

nina: Vendor offering split release: 25 units released, 15 held pending inspection. Theyll ship provisional loaners if we sign a limited RMA acceptance. Vendor proposal: Redwood covers customs brokerage for held units; vendor covers return freight if units confirmed DOA.

omar: Can we push for vendor to cover brokerage too? That seems reasonable given stalls are on customs side.

kevin: Temporary routing plan: add a weighted route to direct 15% traffic to dedicated-eu-fallback if p95 > 200ms for 2min. Also create canary to avoid saturating KV cache.

rma-bot: RMA ticket RMA-2026-076 created, assigned to nina + omar. Docs attached.

nina: Forwarder asks for signed RMA form + letter of financial responsibility for brokerage to pre-clear. Im proposing we sign limited RMA that only covers brokerage up to $28k and stipulates vendor is responsible for return freight on confirmed defects. Thoughts?

omar: Fine with cost cap but loop in finance. Also request vendor provide photos + serial batch CSV now so we can prepare induction.

kevin: Crossdock slot request sent for 03/19 01:00-04:00 UTC for the 25 units if release confirmed. Please confirm staging bay. Alex? (not in thread).

nina: Uploaded redacted manifest snippet: 

```
AWB,SKU,Qty,SerialRange
FRA-CTNR-55021,H100,40,H100-EU-0001-H100-EU-0040
```

procurement-bot: Finance approval pending for cost cap $28k. Approver: mara.finance@example.

nina: Action items: omar - call forwarder and secure provisional pre-clear once RMA signed; kevin - prepare routing/fallback config; finance - confirm cap.

omar: Called forwarder  they said scanned signature + company letterhead required. Filing that now.

kevin: Baseline p95 for eu-edge is 85ms. Will monitor. If we see degradation, I'll trigger route.

nina: I'll sign provisional RMA limited to the brokerage cap once finance confirms. proc-bot please ping when approved.

procurement-bot: Finance approved PR-6789. Budget holder: mara.finance@example.

nina: Signed RMA uploaded to ticket RMA-2026-076 and sent to forwarder. Waiting for confirmation of pre-clear.

omar: Forwarder confirmed pre-clear in principle; customs contact requested additional COO copy and commercial invoice annotated with RMA reference. Ive attached annotated invoice to ticket.

kevin: Crossdock confirmed. Scheduling induction and labeling for 25 units.

rma-bot: Update: Vendor supplied provisional loaner AWB FR-LOAN-33012 for 25 units.

nina: Great. Plan: accept 25 released units into pool, move 6 GPUs from training-pool to cover delta, enable dedicated fallback as standby. If remaining 15 fail inspection, vendor to send permanent replacements under RMA.

kevin: Noting routing snippet for runbook: 

```
if p95_ms > 200 for 120s -> weight dedicated-eu-fallback +15%, ttl 600s
```

nina: Closing loop: omar to confirm final release; kevin to execute routing plan; finance holds cap. Will reopen if customs delays persist.

mara.finance: Acknowledged cost cap and approved provisional RMA coverage.

kevin: Baseline p95 85ms. Will post hourly until canary.

nina: 30m update: forwarder confirmed customs released the 25 units. Crossdock inbound ETA 02:50 UTC. I'll update when inducted.

omar: Confirmed tags preprinted for induction.

kevin: Induction complete at 03:10 UTC, 25 units added to eu-edge pool. Current p95 88ms.

nina: Thanks team. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
